L26: # Release Notes
L27: ## 2026.09.10
L28: ### Bring Google Gemini to your PC with the new Windows app
L29:   * What: The Gemini app is now available on Windows. Press Alt + Space to summon Gemini instantly from anywhere on your PC whenever you need it. You can get quick answers, draft messages, and brainstorm ideas right alongside your active applications. Inside your dedicated desktop workspace, you have access to everything you love about Gemini.
L30: You can connect to Google apps like Gmail and Google Drive to summarize documents and find information quickly, generate custom images with Nano Banana, and dive into in-depth research on any topic.
L31: The app is available on Windows 10 or later. Download it today at cite14†gemini.google/desktop .
L32: 
L33:   * Why: Your desktop is where you get work done. Bringing Gemini straight to your PC with instant shortcut access keeps you in your flow, making it simple to get answers and create visuals right alongside your everyday tools.
L34: ## 2026.08.19
L35: ### A new dedicated student hub, study notebooks on mobile, one year of Google AI Pro in the US, or Google AI Plus in 140+ countries at no cost.
L36:   * What: We’re introducing a dedicated student hub in the Gemini app to help students easily manage classes and create personalized study notebooks from their own course materials like syllabi. Study notebooks—first launched on desktop in June—are now available on mobile to help students get organized, prepare for class and stay on top of their material. Plus, eligible college students can get one year of Google AI Pro in the US, or Google AI Plus in 140+ countries at no cost.
L37:   * Why: By bringing study notebooks to mobile, creating a centralized student hub, and providing a student plan, we are helping students learn with a personalized study partner.
L38: 
L39: Eligible students only. cite18†Offer Terms†one.google.com apply. Redeem until December 31, 2026. Automatically renews at the standard monthly price for the applicable Google AI Plan included in your Offer. Cancel anytime.
L40: ## 2026.07.29
L41: ### Create and edit with your voice, anywhere on your desktop with Gemini on macOS
L42:   * What: We’re introducing a new way to work with Gemini using just your voice, right where you are. Press and hold the Fn key to dictate into your active window and have Gemini transcribe your spoken words into clean, polished text directly at your cursor. You can also enable Gemini reasoning in the app settings to do even more based on screen context—such as highlighting text to rewrite or reformat it, selecting local files to extract information, or generating images anywhere you want.
L43: The new feature is rolling out today in English to all users on the Gemini macOS app. Download the app at cite19†gemini.google/mac .
L44: 
L45:   * Why: Speaking your thoughts lets you work at the speed of thought—allowing you to ramble, hesitate, or self-correct while Gemini seamlessly makes sense of it. By taking in your screen context and outputting results directly at your cursor in any app, Gemini works right alongside you to keep you in your flow.
L46: ## 2026.07.21
L47: ### 3.6 Flash: An upgraded model for your daily life
L48: 
L49:   * What: We’re introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, an upgraded version of our Flash model, to help you tackle everyday tasks. Try using it for quick tasks like analyzing several documents or multi-step projects like building a working prototype with the Canvas tool.
L50: 
L51: We're excited to bring this model to all Gemini app users globally. To access, select "3.6 Flash" in the model drop down.
L52:   * Why: We want to make Gemini the most helpful AI assistant for everyone. With Gemini 3.6 Flash, you can now tackle your everyday tasks with greater confidence, without choosing between speed and quality.
L53: ## 2026.06.30
L54: ### Hand off the heavy lifting to Gemini Spark, now available in the macOS app
L55: 
L56:   * What: Gemini Spark, your personal AI agent, is coming to the Gemini app for macOS. It helps you navigate your digital life by working on tasks on your behalf. Operating autonomously and under your direction, it organizes folders, uses your local files to build documents, and handles complex workflows across Google Workspace.
L57: Coming soon, you will be able to command Gemini Spark to run tasks or access local files on your Mac directly from the web or mobile app, ensuring your desktop workflows remain at your fingertips wherever you go.
L58: 
L59: Starting today, Gemini Spark is available in English in the Gemini macOS app to Google AI Ultra subscribers aged 18 and over in cite20†supported countries†support.google.com . Download the app at cite19†gemini.google/mac .
L60:   * Why: We built this to help you automate your daily busywork, from managing local files to streamlining multi-step projects. With Gemini Spark, we are transforming Gemini from an AI assistant that answers your questions into one that actually works proactively on your behalf.
L61: ## 2026.05.19
L62: ### Gemini Spark is your 24/7 personal AI agent.
L63: 
L64:   * What: Gemini Spark introduces a whole new way to get things done. It helps you navigate your digital life by working on your tasks on your behalf. Gemini Spark is rolling out today to trusted testers and in Beta to Google AI Ultra subscribers aged 18 and over in the United States in the coming weeks. You can access Gemini Spark by tapping on the Spark tab in your Gemini app menu.
L65:   * Why: With Gemini Spark, we are transforming Gemini from an AI assistant that answers your questions into one that actually works proactively on your behalf.
L66: ### Gemini Omni is your creative partner for video creation.
L67:   * What: Gemini Omni helps you create and edit videos as easily as having a conversation. It’s like Nano Banana for videos. Blend any combination of text, photos, and video to create high-quality video. You can even drop yourself right into the action by creating a custom AI avatar that looks and sounds like you. Start from scratch, remix your camera roll, or try out a premade template. Just chat with Gemini naturally to add details, make edits, and watch your ideas come to life.
L68: Gemini Omni is rolling out today in the Gemini app to all Google AI subscribers globally 18 and over, Feature availability varies by region.
L69: 
L70:   * Why: We want to empower users to create, regardless of their technical skill set or access to complex software. With Gemini Omni, your natural language is the only tool you need to direct, refine, and produce captivating videos.
L71: ### Daily Brief is your personalized overview of what matters today.
L72:   * What: Daily Brief is your personalized daily overview built with Gemini. Powered by Personal Intelligence, it distills priorities from your connected apps (like Gmail and Google Calendar from Workspace) and Gemini chats into one intelligent, easy-to-read view. The brief organizes your day to easily see what’s “Top of Mind,” surfacing your immediate priorities with suggested next steps, and helps you “Look Ahead” to make progress on your longer-term goals .
L73: It transforms your morning from scramble to smooth with an actionable plan letting you jump right into the things that actually matter.
L74: Daily Brief is starting to roll out to all Google AI subscribers 18 and over in the United States.
L75: 
L76:   * Why: The hardest part of the day shouldn't be figuring out where to begin. Daily Brief replaces the morning mental gymnastics of checking various apps with a single, prioritized digest so you can save your cognitive energy for the work that really matters.
L77: ### 3.5 Flash delivers frontier-level intelligence for your daily life.
L78: 
L79:   * What: Gemini 3.5 Flash is our best model yet for getting challenging tasks done quickly and efficiently, giving you frontier-level intelligence at speed. Whether you need help with everyday tasks, like analyzing multiple documents quickly or multi-step projects, like prototyping or vibe coding, 3.5 Flash is designed to navigate real-world complexity and help you take action.
L80: Rolling out to everyone globally. To access, select “3.5 Flash” in the model drop down.
L81: 
L82:   * Why: We want to make Gemini the most helpful AI assistant for everyone. With Gemini 3.5 Flash, you can now tackle your everyday tasks with greater confidence, without choosing between speed and quality.
L83: ### The next chapter of Gemini Live.
L84: 
L85:   * What: Gemini Live is now integrating into chat, allowing you to switch seamlessly between talking and typing. Gemini now connects directly with your favorite apps to handle the heavy lifting–from comparing products to catching up on emails. While you talk, Gemini will even show you information like real-time maps, weather cards, or you can show Gemini what you’re seeing to dream up new images with Nano Banana. Just talk and let Gemini handle the rest.
L86: Rolling out globally to Android and iOS users.
L87: 
L88:   * Why: We’re making Gemini a more complete hands-free assistant. By working directly with your favorite tools, Gemini provides frictionless help through natural conversation.
L89: ### Gemini responses are now even richer, more dynamic, and interactive.
L90:   * What: Instead of just reading a wall of text, for specific topics Gemini can show more interactive explorations, so you can zoom deep into high-resolution images to spotlight layer-by-layer information, or generate engaging narrated video overviews of 30-60 seconds. These new responses can also include interleaven images, timelines, and more. For every prompt, Gemini will reason through the best way to organize information to ensure you get the right information in a format that works for you.
L91: Interactive multi-layer images and Video Overviews are available in English globally for specific topics when using the “Pro” model.
L92: 
L93:   * Why: As part of our new Neural Expressive design language, we’re moving past a plain wall of text to beautifully crafted, immersive interactions directly in your Gemini main chat. We want to make sure your AI assistant is more intelligent, adaptive, and naturally works with whatever modality is best for you.
L94: ### Introducing a new $100 Google AI Ultra plan.
L95: 
L96:   * What: Get the best of Gemini with Google AI Ultra subscriptions now starting at $100/month. Subscribers get higher access to our advanced Gemini models and powerful features like video generation with Gemini Omni and more. AI Ultra $100/month also includes additional benefits such as 20TB of cloud storage and YouTube Premium.
L97: 
L98: Available globally.
L99:   * Why: We're committed to bringing you Google's latest AI innovations faster. Google AI Ultra is designed for our most dedicated users, giving them the best of Gemini and Google AI wherever they are. In addition, Ultra subscribers get priority access to our newest AI advancements, helping them shape the future of AI. cite21†Upgrade to Google AI Ultra.†one.google.com L100: ### Gemini can connect to more apps, starting with OpenTable, Canva, and Instacart.
L101: 
L102:   * What: Gemini can now connect to even more apps you use every day, starting with OpenTable, Canva, and Instacart. Whether you are booking a table at a new restaurant tailored to your taste, ordering groceries for a family recipe, or creating a flyer—Gemini doesn’t just find information; it helps you take action seamlessly with connected apps.
L103: We are currently in the process of rolling out OpenTable (en-US), Canva (en*), and Instacart (en-US), which will become fully available to all eligible users over the next few weeks.
L104: 
L105:   * Why: Gemini is evolving to help you take action, going beyond simply finding information. It acts as an intelligent orchestrator across a growing network of connected apps, starting with OpenTable, Canva, and Instacart, with many more on the way, including partners like Zillow, Adobe, and Box.
L106: ## 2026.04.15
L107: ### Meet your new desktop assistant: Gemini for Mac
L108: 
L109:   * What: We’re introducing the Gemini app for Mac, a native desktop experience built to help you get more done without disrupting your flow. With a simple keyboard shortcut (Option + Space), you can bring up Gemini alongside any application you're using. You can also seamlessly share your window, allowing Gemini to understand your context and assist with exactly what’s on your screen.
L110: The new desktop app is available to users on macOS versions 15 and up, globally, for free.
L111: 
L112: Download the app directly at cite19†gemini.google/mac .
L113: 
L114:   * Why: By bringing a native app to Mac, we're cutting down on context switching and giving you a faster, more integrated way to use Gemini alongside the tools you use every day.
L115: ## 2026.03.26
L116: ### Make the switch: Seamlessly bring your AI memories and chat history to Gemini
L117:   * What: Starting today, we are rolling out new switching tools to your Settings page for all consumer accounts. You can now easily cite22†import your personal context, preferences, and full chat history from other AI apps directly into Gemini . To bring over your memories, simply select the import option in Settings, paste the suggested prompt into your other AI app, and copy its generated summary back into Gemini.
L118: You can also seamlessly pick up where you left off by uploading a ZIP file of your chat history from other providers. Additionally, we are renaming the "past chats" feature to "memories," which will roll out in the app over the next few weeks.
L119:   * Why: The most helpful AI assistant is one that understands your preferences and past conversations. Starting over with a new assistant can feel daunting, so we created these tools to let you quickly get Gemini up to speed on what matters most to you without starting from scratch. By bringing over your key facts and past conversation threads, you can pick up right where you left off and continue building on your ideas right inside Gemini.
L120: ## 2026.02.19
L121: ### Gemini 3.1 Pro: A smarter model for your most complex tasks
L122:   * What: Building on the Gemini 3 series, we’re releasing 3.1 Pro, a smarter and more capable model for complex problem-solving. 3.1 Pro is designed for tasks where a simple answer isn’t enough, taking advanced reasoning and making it useful for your hardest challenges.
L123: This improved intelligence can help in practical applications — whether you’re looking for a clear, visual explanation of a complex topic, a way to synthesize data into a single view, or a step-by-step plan bringing an ambitious creative project to life.
L124: 3.1 Pro is rolling out globally to the Gemini app, with higher limits for users with Google AI Pro and Ultra plans. To access, select “Pro” in the model drop down.
L125: 
L126:   * Why: We want to make Gemini the most helpful AI assistant for everyone. With the advanced reasoning of Gemini 3.1 Pro, you can now tackle your most complex projects with greater confidence.
L127: ## 2026.02.12
L128: ### Solve modern science, research and engineering challenges with Gemini 3 Deep Think
L129: 
L130:   * What: We’re releasing a major upgrade to Gemini 3 Deep Think, our specialized reasoning mode, built to push the frontier of intelligence and solve modern challenges across science, research, and engineering. By blending deep scientific knowledge with everyday engineering utility, Deep Think now moves beyond abstract theory to help drive practical applications.
L131: This update is available to Google AI Ultra Subscribers in the Gemini App. To access, select “Deep Think” in the prompt bar. Once you submit your task, Gemini will let you know when your response is ready – generally in a few minutes.
L132: 
L133:   * Why: We're committed to bringing Google's latest AI innovations faster to Google AI Ultra users, including our most powerful reasoning capabilities to help you tackle even more complex problems.
L134: ## 2026.01.28
L135: ### Meet your new AI browsing assistant: Gemini in Chrome
L136:   * What: We’re introducing major updates to cite23†Gemini in Chrome†support.google.com to help you get the most out of the web. L147: ## 2025.12.17
L148: ### Introducing Gemini 3 Flash, a major upgrade to your everyday AI

L161: ## 2025.12.04
L162: ### Solve even more complex problems with Gemini 3 Deep Think
L163:   * What: Starting today, Google AI Ultra subscribers get access to Gemini 3 Deep Think, Gemini’s most advanced reasoning mode.
